mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Driver of the Dead: "When this creature dies, return target creature card with mana value 2
# or less from your graveyard to the battlefield."
# M20 Cavalier of Night's verified dies trigger ("When this creature dies, return target creature
# card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.") with 2: CreatureDiesEvent
# IS_SOURCE, MOVE_ZONE of a TARGET creature card with CMC_LE 2 from your graveyard (the `cards`
# role) to the battlefield.
dies = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
        'cards': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CMC_LE, count=QConst(value=2)),
            )),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
        ),
        'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
    }),
)
abilities = [dies, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature dies, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (CreatureDiesEvent IS_SOURCE; MOVE_ZONE TARGET creature card CMC_LE 2 from your graveyard to the battlefield)
